description: Database schema for TalentTree AI Chat persistence and memory tracking.

tables.name: AiSessions
tables.description: Tracks active or historical AI chat sessions per business owner profile.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique session GUID or session identifier string.

columns.name: BusinessOwnerProfileId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES BusinessOwnerProfile(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: ID linking to the business owner profile context.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Descriptive title of the chat session.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the session was last updated.

tables.name: AiMessages
tables.description: Stores individual chat messages exchange in each session.

columns.name: SessionId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES AiSessions(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: Foreign key pointing to the session.

columns.name: Role
columns.description: Role of the speaker. Values: 'user' or 'assistant'.

columns.name: Content
columns.description: Text content of the message (supports markdown and base64 html image tags).

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

tables.name: AiAgentExecutions
tables.description: Logs details of agent execution, intermediate routing traces, and time metrics.

columns.name: SessionId
constraints: FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES AiSessions(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.description: Foreign key pointing to the active session.

columns.name: InputData
columns.description: Copy of the user query sent to the agent.

columns.name: OutputData
columns.description: Copy of the response generated by the agent.

columns.name: ExecutionTimeMs
columns.description: Time taken to execute the agent in milliseconds.
